title: Compact retention indexer + cosign signer for private-installer release pipeline
author: Lina Moreno
description: Motivation: our private-installer release pipeline did not have a compact, signed rollforward index optimized for long retention windows. This caused large manifest churn and slowed upgrades for air-gapped customers. This PR introduces a compact 'delta-rollforward' index format and integrates cosign signing + signature rotation hooks into the private-installer CI. It also wires the Terraform module for installer releases to stamp retention policies and exposes a Helm chart checksum annotation so operator upgrades are only triggered when the signed index changes. Changes: - New CI job ci/release/delta-rollforward-indexer.yml that builds a compact delta index (delta-index-v2) from artifact metadata and emits provenance pointers. - Cosign signing step and key-rotation-friendly layout under ci/secrets/cosign-rotation.sh (invoked only in release pipeline). - Terraform module changes in infra/terraform/modules/installer-release to add release_retention_days and signed_index_bucket arguments. - Helm chart patch: charts/private-installer/templates/_helpers.tpl and deployment annotations to include release-index-checksum and signed-index-url. - Release orchestrator: release/orchestrator/merge-rollforward.py updated to publish both full and delta indexes and to annotate releases with signed index digest. - Migration script: tools/installer/migrate-retention.sh for on-prem customers to opt-in to delta-index and to backfill signed pointers. Testing: - Unit tests for indexer format and validation added under release/indexer/tests/ - End-to-end staging run in our private staging account validated: signed index uploaded, terraform module applied, Helm upgrade performed without pod restarts unless index digest changed. Checklist: - [x] Add delta indexer job and unit tests - [x] Integrate cosign signing and rotation hooks - [x] Terraform module argument & docs updates - [x] Helm chart annotation and integration smoke test - [x] Migration helper for existing air-gapped installs - [x] Add release notes entry Notes: - This PR intentionally keeps the full index publishing unchanged; the delta index is additive and will be consumed by the private-installer as an opt-in config (release_retention_mode: delta). - Cosign uses ephemeral key material in CI with rotation helper; production rotation should follow the rotation runbook in docs/security/key-rotation.md. - See Linear items ENG-2876 and PLATFORM-912 for rollout plan and operational runbooks.
